events.title: Ukrainian drone attack on Russian beach
events.description: A Ukrainian drone attack on a Russian beach near Putin's palace has killed six people, including three children.

events.title: Ceuta migrant crisis exposes divisions within Europe
events.description: The Ceuta migrant crisis has exposed divisions within Europe.

events.title: Ceuta Leader Accuses Morocco Over Mass Border Crossing
events.description: The leader of Ceuta accused Morocco of being responsible for the mass border crossing, stating that it was 'at least encouraged or permitted' by Rabat.

events.title: Morocco Blames Ceuta Border Surge on Misleading Info Spread Online
events.description: Morocco blamed the surge of migrants into Ceuta on the spread of misleading information online and 'malicious exploitation of digital platforms'.

events.title: Boris Nadezhdin, anti-war candidate in Russia, flees to France
events.description: Russian anti-war candidate Boris Nadezhdin has fled to France after being prohibited from running in parliamentary elections.

events.title: Red Cross meets with Myanmar's detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi
events.description: The Red Cross met with Myanmar's detained former leader Aung San Suu Kyi, in her first known contact with the outside world since the 2021 coup.

events.title: Spain's Ceuta Overwhelmed As Thousands Remain After Migrant Border Rush
events.description: The Spanish territory of Ceuta is struggling to cope with the thousands of migrants who remain after a massive border rush last week.

events.title: Spain says 'vast majority' of Ceuta migrants have returned
events.description: Spain's foreign minister said nearly all migrants who crossed into Ceuta have left, with many returned to Morocco.

events.title: Iran denies Trump claim that new talks will start Monday
events.description: Iran denies that talks with the US are taking place, despite President Trump's claim that new talks will start on Monday.

events.title: Morocco blames Ceuta chaos on misinformation and human trafficking
events.description: Morocco’s government said factors such as misinformation and human trafficking lured tens of thousands of migrants into illegally crossing into the Spanish-governed northern African enclave of Ceuta.

events.title: Earthquake hits Egypt, triggering emergency response
events.description: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake struck near the Egyptian city of Suez, shaking buildings across Cairo and prompting authorities to activate emergency response plans.

events.title: Myanmar allows glimpse of ousted leader Suu Kyi
events.description: Myanmar's military-backed government has released photographs of Aung San Suu Kyi meeting a representative of the International Committee of the Red Cross.

events.title: US and Japan jointly intervene to prop up yen in rare move
events.description: Both countries have said that they will not hesitate to conduct joint interventions in the future.

events.title: 14 killed in suspected suicide bombing in Pakistan
events.description: At least 14 people were killed in a suspected suicide bombing outside a police station in northwestern Pakistan

events.title: Ukraine seeks more US Patriot interceptors as bomb shelter probe deepens
events.description: A former Ukrainian official describes 'scandalous situations' in bomb shelters as Volodymyr Zelenskyy pushes partners for 300 Patriot interceptors.

events.title: Ukraine seeks more US Patriot interceptors
events.description: Ukraine is seeking additional US Patriot interceptors as it faces ongoing conflict with Russian-backed separatists.

events.title: Local volunteers help rebuild destroyed Christian monastery in Lebanon
events.description: Interfaith volunteers rebuild war-damaged Catholic monastery in Lebanon’s Zawtar al-Gharbiyeh.

events.title: Two crew killed as firefighting helicopters collide in midair in Greece
events.description: Two crew members were killed on Sunday when two helicopters battling a wildfire collided in midair in the Psatha area, on the boundary between Attica and Boeotia northwest of Athens.

events.title: Top Saudi, Iranian diplomats discuss de-escalation efforts in region
events.description: Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al-Saud stressed that Riyadh is committed to continuing to play its regional role in ensuring security and stability.

events.title: Two crew killed after firefighting helicopters collide in Greece
events.description: One Danish and one Greek national died in the incident, while a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.

events.title: Pakistan: Suicide bomber kills 14 at anti-militancy protest
events.description: A suicide bomber has killed more than a dozen people, including police, in an attack during a demonstration of citizens against militancy.

events.title: Moroccans gather at Ceuta border, desperate for news of loved ones
events.description: Dozens of Moroccans gathered on Sunday in the town of Fnideq, desperately seeking news of their loved ones who were among the thousands who swam across the nearby border to the Spanish territory of Ceuta.

events.title: Iran says deal with Oman to manage shipping through Hormuz is close
events.description: Negotiations on an agreement seen as critical to preventing the US-Iran war from escalating are said to be in ‘final stages’

events.title: At least 72 dead amid mass migrant rush to storm Spanish enclave of Ceuta
events.description: At least 72 migrants are dead as Spain searches for more victims and a deadly border crossing sparks renewed political tensions across Europe.

events.title: Brazil's Lula launches reelection bid
events.description: Brazil’s President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has confirmed his candidacy for what is likely his last reelection bid.

events.title: Suicide bomber kills 14 outside police station in Pakistan
events.description: A suicide bomber targeted protesters at an anti-militant rally in northwestern Pakistan, killing at least 14 people, including police officers, and wounding more than two dozen others.

events.title: 13 Killed In Suicide Blast During Peace Rally In Pakistan
events.description: The blast happened when a peace rally was going on in a town in Swat district, Pakistan

events.title: Japan, US carried out joint forex intervention Friday for 1st time since 2011
events.description: Japan and the US carried out a joint forex intervention on Friday, the first such move since 2011.

events.title: Two dead after firefighting helicopters crash in Greece
events.description: The two-man crew of a firefighting helicopter has been killed in a mid-air collision in Greece as forces battled multiple wildfires.

events.title: Tankers 'waiting for permission' to transit through Strait of Hormuz, Iran says
events.description: Iran's semiofficial Fars news agency aired footage of what it said were vessels 'waiting for permission' from Iran to transit through the Strait of Hormuz.
